snippet.title: Hollow Ones - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Bunker Echo-7, your new home and shelter from the massacre outside. Deformed humanoid creatures stalk the surface above, but the real monsters may be in the bunker with you. 

Zombies, mutants and aliens. Nobody knows what they are or where they came from, but it’s clear they’ve come to end humanity. Everyone you knew is already gone.

What are these creatures? What is Echo-7, and what are its residents hiding from you? Ask questions. Search for answers. Just remember that satisfying your curiosity won't bring the world back.
